data.why: The repo bundles its own LFIA strip photos (Blank/0.1/0.5/1.0 ng AuNP) under samples/, and the app UI already has one-click preset pills that load these exact files directly from the server, so no synthetic data is needed.

goals: Build a 4PL calibration curve from a dilution series of LFIA strip images and determine the assay's Limit of Detection (LoD) per CLSI EP17-A2
Quantify the concentration of an unknown sample strip against a previously built standard curve with a 95% prediction interval
Check replicate reproducibility (mean, SD, %CV) across triplicate strips at each concentration level
Verify a suspected hook (prozone) effect using the two-point 1:10 dilution parallelism test
Export publication-ready calibration curve figures and an analytical audit report (parameters a,b,c,d, LoB, LoD, LLoQ, ULoQ, LDR)

review.summary: The tree follows the main RapidQuant workflow from setup through strip densitometry to a 4PL curve, CLSI EP17-A2 limits, recovery/%CV and unknown concentrations, with clean general labels and evidence that mostly checks out. It leaves out two of the five plan goals (hook verification and full report export) plus save/reload, and it merges the LoD and Unknown workflows in ways the replay contradicts, so it should be fixed before filing.
